---Vortex---
                               ---[original from pack: {2} But how you've grown]---
  __
   | his one has gone a long way... And I must've watched the product    for hours, if not days now!

   Many thanks for commenting on the pre-release and for teaching        and thus inspiration goes out to Pak-9! His supreme "AVS- Program-    ming Guide" is definitely worth reading.

   The left color selector is supposed to be the color of the warphole      itself, the right one the color of the light emerging from the very            center. The lighting color usually has more effect. Now go play           around with those!
   Interface can be turned on/off with the CTRL-key.
   New random color combo is selected with the SHIFT-key.

   This is the edit for "Skin-Consortium's" skin "Vortex" and con-             tains stuff from various AVS artists [in adding-time order] :
      -> "Beat Digestion" preset as a startoff [it's actually exactly the                same shape] by me, Grandchild,
      -> The *very slightly* modified starfield by Pak-9 from "Time                     Probe" released in "PAK-9 - AVS 5"
          [http://www.winamp.com/plugins/details.php?id=146035]
          [visit: http://pak-9.deviantart.com],
      -> The little blue comets by El-Vis
          [visit: http://el-vis.deviantart.com],
      -> And last but not at all at least the hsb/hsv code and interface             by ASD5A and a little afterwork from me. Thanks for your help            pal!
      The code is written by me if the equal sign is embraced by                  spaces: var = a;
      All others would be: var=a;

   PS: Thanks to QuadHelix for motivation to pick this one up again!

   --- Grandchild ---
   http://grandchild.deviantart.com
   ezt@freenet.de

   Feel free to use parts of it if you want, just send me a mail so I can      see what you made of it!

---Vortex---                                                                      VII - XII - MMV

code.perPoint: // globals

code.perFrame: fr=fr-frb;ry=10*sin(fr);new=if(below(dz,-1),1,0);dz=if(new,20+rand(5),dz-s);dx=if(new,rand(100)/10-5,dx);dy=if(new,rand(100)/10-5,dy);ys=sin(ry/p3);yc=cos(ry/p3);
code.onBeat:
frb=0.1*getspec(0.1,0,0);

// all code here by El-Vis

n = 100*below(reg17,5);
n = 100*below(reg18,5);

n = 100*below(reg20,5);
n = 100*below(reg21,5);
